dcat_keyword_sm: Osoyoos Division of Yale Land District
dct_creator_sm: Mohun, Edward (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced reference map of Westbank Nation reserves Mission Creek 8, Tsinstikeptum 9, Tsinstikeptum 10; and Okanagan Band reserves Duck Lake 7, Commonage Reserve, Priest's Valley 6, Long Lake, Okanagan 1, Swan Lake 4, Harris 3 and Otter Lake 2; and Splatsin Nation reserves Enderby 2 and Salmon River 1 all near Okanagan Lake. Land cover and features described on the map includes Salmon River, trails from Kamloops to Penticton, graveyards, Otter Lake, Meadow Creek, Long Lake Creek, and Long Lake.
